passed_tests: Homepage with aeronautical hero loads correctly
Transparency page displays institutional metrics (150 sócios, 135 ativos, 90% adimplência, 810K CVE)

Backend APIs: auth, users, invoices, polls, documents, benefits, statistics, audit logs
